summary: Cabaletta Bio, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) under its existing shelf registration statement to sell 51,725,000 shares of common stock at $2.90 per share in an underwritten public offering, with total proceeds of approximately $150 million before expenses. The offering price represents a slight discount to the last sale price of $2.94. The transaction is a standard equity follow-on offering, not a special situation. Shares are expected to deliver on May 5, 2026. The offering is being conducted by joint book-running managers TD Cowen, Guggenheim Securities, and Cantor, with H.C. Wainwright as lead manager. This is a routine capital-raising event.
